name.description: File name to associate with the artifact

type.description:
Classification for the artifact

* `plan` - plan
* `context` - context
* `reference` - reference
* `output` - output
* `artifact` - artifact
* `tree_snapshot` - tree_snapshot
* `user_attachment` - user_attachment

source.description: Optional source label for the artifact, such as agent_output or user_attachment

content.description: Artifact contents encoded according to content_encoding

content_encoding.description:
Encoding used for content. Use base64 for binary files and utf-8 for text payloads.

* `utf-8` - utf-8
* `base64` - base64

content_type.description: Optional MIME type for the artifact
